label: violates
requirement: Guests can use a swimming pool located at the booked property for no additional charge during the described stay.
meaning_constraints: Use varied counterexamples: separate fee, pool offsite only, no pool, pool closed all stay, booked room/rate excludes access, decorative pool where swimming prohibited.

clauses.text: Q: Is there a fee for the pool? A: Yes, the onsite swimming pool costs EUR 12 per use, in addition to the room price.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the specific fee, currency, location, and the fact that it is extra to the room price.

clauses.text: Dear client, please note this accommodation has no pool; the only swimming pool is at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the negation of a pool on-site and the specific location of the alternative facility.

clauses.text: *Please note: The hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay.
clauses.rationale: Kept the reason for closure and the specific duration covering the whole stay.

clauses.text: Your booking for the budget rate expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed to access it.
clauses.rationale: Retained the specific rate type, the exclusion of the pool, and the requirement for a paid upgrade.

clauses.text: Access to the onsite swimming pool incurs a charge of EUR 12 per use, in addition to the room price.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the exact cost, currency, usage condition, and the relationship to the room price.

clauses.text: Note: This accommodation has no pool; the only swimming pool is at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the absence of a pool and the specific location of the nearby alternative.

clauses.text: I am sorry to inform you that the hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the reason for closure and the fact that it lasts for the entire booked stay.

clauses.text: The booked budget rate expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed.
clauses.rationale: Kept the specific rate name, the exclusion, and the necessity of a paid upgrade.

clauses.text: Onsite swimming pool: EUR 12 per use (in addition to the room price).
clauses.rationale: Preserved the location, the exact fee, and the condition regarding the room price.

clauses.text: Please be advised this accommodation has no pool; the only swimming pool is at a separate nearby leisure centre.
clauses.rationale: Maintained the negation of an onsite pool and the specific location of the nearby leisure centre.

clauses.text: The hotel pool is closed for repairs for the entire booked stay.
clauses.rationale: Preserved the reason for closure and the duration of the entire booked stay.

clauses.text: Budget Rate: Expressly excludes the onsite pool; a paid upgrade is needed.
clauses.rationale: Kept the specific rate, the exclusion of the pool, and the requirement for a paid upgrade.
